versions.changelog:
**Expanded invocation options and improved provider logic.**

- Added support for explicit invocation via aliases (e.g., "scrask this", "screenshot"), allowing users to force the skill on ambiguous images.
- Default provider routing now uses OpenClaw's vision LLM unless user-supplied Gemini or Claude keys are provided, enabling out-of-the-box operation for all users.
- GEMINI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are now fully optional and only used if present.
- Updated documentation to clarify invocation modes, environment variable use, and fallback logic.
- No code or file changes; these are manifest and documentation improvements for clarity and usability.

**Major refactor: Scrask bot is now a screenshot-to-intent parser that emits structured events/tasks for other skills to handle.**

- No longer writes directly to Google Calendar or Tasks; routes extracted intent to any installed destination skill (e.g. calctl, apple-calendar, notion).
- Now works on any chat surface (Telegram, iMessage, Slack, etc.), not just Telegram.
- Switched from immediate write/delete actions to structured, confidence-driven item extraction with rich clarification and threshold logic.
- Expanded config for fine-grained per-field, type, and actionable confidence gates.
- New script and documentation files added under docs/ and scripts/, replacing old monolithic files.
- Improved guidance and output structure for downstream skill integration and user-facing clarifications.
Version 1.0.1 Use at your own risk
